preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: adj is a list of lists where each list contains the neighbors of a vertex
preconditions.description: The adjacency list representation of the graph is provided.

preconditions.expression: The graph is undirected and connected
preconditions.description: The graph is guaranteed to be undirected and connected, meaning there is at least one path between any two vertices.

postconditions.expression: The output list contains all the articulation points of the graph
postconditions.description: An articulation point is a vertex whose removal increases the number of connected components in the graph. The output list contains all such vertices.

postconditions.expression: If there are no articulation points, the output list contains -1
postconditions.description: If the graph has no articulation points, the output list contains only the value -1.

invariants.expression: The output list is sorted in ascending order
invariants.description: The output list of articulation points is sorted in ascending order.
